summary_en: Riso Kagaku will acquire up to 210,000 shares (0.34% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥200 million via open market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 19 and December 23, 2026, to flexibly execute capital policy and enhance shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, the Board of Directors of Riso Kagaku Corporation resolved to acquire treasury shares pursuant to the Company Law. The company will purchase up to 210,000 ordinary shares representing 0.34% of outstanding shares (calculated from 62,165,784 shares outstanding excluding treasury shares as of September 30, 2026) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥200 million.

The acquisition will be conducted via open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on an executed trade basis between November 19, 2026 and December 23, 2026. The company stated that the purpose of the acquisition is to enable flexible execution of capital policy in response to changes in the business environment and to enhance returns to shareholders.
